current_inheritance.delta: Baseline freeze must include executable call-graph/runtime route receipts. Add a test that every visual response's reported provider/backbone/model/version matches the actually invoked path.
Persist visual provider_id, implementation_version, model/backbone identity and route_reason from the execution boundary, not UI labels or stale module names.
Represent AVAILABLE_FILE, ACTIVE_CALLSITE, SUPERSEDED_IMPLEMENTATION and STALE_LABEL as distinct relation/status classes.
Perception receipts should type implementation identity separately from semantic sensor type; visual_sensor does not imply FrankEye/NativeVision/Retina.
Feature-backbone compatibility must bind to the actual active feature producer. A learner checkpoint cannot declare compatibility by historical subsystem name alone.
Create stale-provenance fixture: migrate visual backend while intentionally leaving old model label; test must fail until execution and reported provenance agree.

cheap_discriminating_tests: Invoke WebUI upload, gateway /chat/vision, see, see_deep, VCB audit and agentic error screenshot under instrumented import hooks; assert each route emits the actual NativeVision implementation/version receipt.
Temporarily rename/remove frank_eye.py in a controlled fixture and verify all claimed current visual routes still work; any hidden dependency becomes explicit.
Force NativeVision unavailable and record whether any path falls back to FrankEye. No fallback should be inferred from file presence; it must be directly observed and receipted.
